senses.gloss:
स्कन्द

SKANDA . subrahmaṇya. (For further details see under subrahmaṇya).

स्कन्दग्रह

SKANDAGRAHA . An evil spirit which afflicts boys upto the age of sixteen. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Vana Parva, Chapter 230, Stanza 43, that this spirit is also known by the name Mātṛkāgraha or Puruṣagraha.

स्कन्दापस्मार

SKANDĀPASMĀRA . A demon derived from the body of subrahmaṇya. This would enter the womb of pregnant women and afflict the child in the womb. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 230, Verse 26).

स्कन्ध

SKANDHA . A nāga (serpent) born in the family of dhṛtarāṣṭra. This serpent was burnt to death in the sacrificial fire of the serpent sacrifice of janamejaya. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 57, Verse 18).

स्कन्धाक्ष

SKANDHĀKṢA . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (mahābhārata, śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 60).
